messages.text: Searched the catalog · Harlo B30 Magic Miner 40T

The B30 is $899, ~30 TH/s at roughly 360-450W, about 50 dB. Power is the whole story here, so tell me your state or country and what you pay per kWh if you know it, and I'll give you the sats per month, the power cost and the break-even BTC price for your place.

Honest framing up front: at retail power this is about stacking sats and a solo-block lottery shot, not net profit at today's price.
